name: lld-practice-platform
description: Preview runner only. The real app is the Python/FastAPI backend in backend/ — see README.md.

scripts.dev: sh -c 'test -d .venv || uv venv .venv -q; uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python -r backend/requirements.txt; cd backend && ../.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-3000} --reload'
